description:
Drinko helps you make better cocktails at home with classic recipes, bartending tutorials, and a smart cabinet to track ingredients.

Explore 140+ classic cocktail recipes and 40+ shots — from a Negroni and Old Fashioned to a Margarita, Daiquiri, Mojito, and Gin Tonic — learn essential bartending techniques, save your favorites, and see what's already in your home bar and spirits cabinet before you shop.

Make it yours: add your own recipes with a photo, turn it into a sticker, and share any recipe as a card with friends. Your favorites and settings stay in sync across iPhone, iPad, and Mac with iCloud.

Drinko is built for beginners and cocktail enthusiasts who want to mix with more confidence, improve their technique, and stay organized behind the bar.
promotionalText: Make it yours: turn photos of your own cocktails into stickers, share recipe cards with friends, and mix 36 new shots in a fully redesigned Drinko.
whatsNew:
Make every cocktail yours: snap a photo of your own creation and Drinko turns it into a sticker that sits right beside the classics. Plus 36 new shots and a fresh look.

New
• Add a photo to your own cocktails, turn it into a sticker, or pick a card color
• Share any recipe as a beautiful card — friends can open it instantly with an App Clip, no download needed
• 36 new shots, including the Ferrari Shot, plus Campari classics like the Milano-Torino and Garibaldi
• Favorites, recently viewed drinks and settings now sync across your iPhone, iPad and Mac with iCloud
• Ready for iPhone Duo, and for multitasking alongside your other apps

Improved
• Redesigned Cocktails and Learn: switch between cards and list, and jump back in from your recently viewed drinks
• Cocktail pages are now tidy, collapsible cards for history, ingredients and method
• Search by ingredient: type "gin" to find every drink that uses it
• A new Tools tab gathers the calculators, including a live ABV calculator
• Choose your recipe units in Settings; they start out matching your region
• On iPad: a new sidebar, plus keyboard shortcuts for creating cocktails and switching tabs
• Fewer interruptions: promotions appear less often
